  "n_predictors": 7,

  "rationale": "As a set, these columns open up genuinely informative, human-interpretable relationships around visit_duration_min: acuity, instability, diagnostic and intervention intensity, organ system, and chronicity are all external associational axes with clean, well-separated categories suitable for grouping and comparison against urgency, department, and age group. They avoid opaque scores and mechanical features. Deductions: visit_reason_category largely restates the existing reason_for_visit field, several binaries (chronic_disease_component, multi_system_involvement, clinical_instability) overlap conceptually with symptom_acuity and intervention columns, creating redundancy, and primary_organ_system has some near-empty categories limiting comparison.
